    • playCard

      public void playCard(int indexCard, int angle, String cardID, int side) throws TargetNotPresentException, InvalidAngleCoveredException, InvalidPositionException, RequirementsNotRespectedException
      This method actually puts the card (found at the index position of the cards list) into the player's table, covering the angle (angle) of the card that's given by the card ID. ps: the card ha sto be put down by the side that's specified by the "side" attribute.
      Parameters:
      indexCard - : index of the card that you want to play that's found into the cards list (list of the playable cards of that specific player)
      angle - : this attribute stands for the angle that you want to cover by positioning the card you're playing
      cardID - : this attribute stands for the card ID of the card that you want to cover by playing the card
      side - : this attribute specifies if the player want to play the card by the front or the back
      Throws:
      TargetNotPresentException - if the target is not present
      InvalidAngleCoveredException - if positioning the angle in that spot is incorrect
      InvalidPositionException - if positioning the card in that spot is incorrect
      RequirementsNotRespectedException

    • chooseObjectiveCard

      public void chooseObjectiveCard(int index) throws InvalidPlayingException
      This method chooses the secret objective of the player. Basically, this method, chooses one (the one that's in the index position) of the two objective cards that have been given.
      Parameters:
      index - : this attribute stands for the index of the card that the player want to choose
      Throws:
      InvalidPlayingException - if the player has already chosen their objective card
